product_updates.title: Ollie, a privacy-focused AI assistant, is shutting down
product_updates.content: As an increasing number of AI assistants flood the market, the founder of Ollie, an assistant that respected its users' privacy, says it will be shutting down in a week.

product_updates.title: Intel’s stock crashes, knocking $12B from government’s stake
product_updates.content: Intel is being hurt by PC sales as the AI industry gobbles memory and other components causing PC prices to rise.

product_updates.title: Anthropic expected to receive high ‘junk’ rating from credit agencies following IPO, FT report says
product_updates.content: Blackstone's forecast is just a prediction, but naturally, a high junk rating would make it more difficult and costlier for Anthropic to raise the money to keep funding its massive spending that has undergirded its business.

product_updates.title: Last-minute Halloween costumes for tech nerds
product_updates.content: No Halloween costume? Just be a deceptively cute AI agent icon, a PHP vulnerability, or sleepy time Bryan Johnson.

product_updates.title: Cracks are emerging in the AI spending boom
product_updates.content: Big Tech is pouring billions into AI infrastructure, but mounting debt, negative cash flow, and growing investor skepticism are raising questions about the sustainability of the AI spending boom.

product_updates.title: Zest’s new AI agent finds restaurants and books reservations over text
product_updates.content: Can't agree on where to eat? Zest's AI concierge can combine everyone's tastes, put restaurant options to a vote, and make the reservation.

product_updates.title: Google’s first data center satellite is online and writing poetry
product_updates.content: The first TPU in space is running a Google DeepMind Gemma 4 model and writing cheesy poetry.

product_updates.title: Theranos whistleblower Tyler Shultz warns that the AI boom is ‘a great opportunity to go deceive people’
product_updates.content: The cautionary Theranos tale takes on a new significance in the AI era, when companies that have never turned a profit are raising capital at trillion-dollar valuations.

product_updates.content: DoorDash said that it is open to working with third-party agent makers.
